verdict.rationale: Docs show programmatic session management: isolated cloud browser sessions are created via API/SDK, and each exposes a WebSocket endpoint for Playwright, Puppeteer or CDP control. A community pricing comparison implies plan-based concurrency allowances, but no first-party doc in the pack states concurrency limits or describes running fleets in parallel. missing for 10: documented per-plan concurrency limits, explicit parallel/fleet session orchestration docs (list/stop/batch), hands-on corroboration of running many concurrent sessions.
